what_this_is_not: R values are copied from the tracked fixture. Julia values are computed fresh by tools/true_parity_julia_receipts.jl, which repeats the computation of the cited twin test with the same inputs and settings; R was not run and is not recomputed here.

cases.quantity: maximised logLik of the Gaussian fit with a zero offset
cases.note: Rank-2 Gaussian fit on ns_gauss_p1_data.csv (p = 6, n = 200, sha256 checked), R: value ~ 0 + trait + offset(0) + latent(0 + trait | unit, d = 2, unique = FALSE), converged with a positive-definite Hessian; same optimum (logLik within 1e-6, asserted in the test); R's fit equals R's plain fit (asserted in the generator). Julia: offset = zeros(6, 200). Scope: a ZERO offset on a non-count trait, the one offset R allows there. R refuses a nonzero offset on a Gaussian trait (message recorded in the fixture); Julia accepts one (asserted in the test), so that behaviour is a difference, not a match, and is not compared.
